271:t_1:4.en:
$$葵$$
「...Something inside me is about to explode...!」

271:t_1:5.en:
$$葵$$
「So this is the wild...! The primal instinct sleeping inside every human...!」

271:t_1:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Faster, higher... stronger...! We fight in order to live!」

271:t_1:10.en:
$$シモン$$
(...There was no wind blowing in underground $$ジーハ村$$...)

271:t_1:11.en:
$$シモン$$
(But ever since I came up to the surface with Bro and $$ヨーコ$$, there's always been wind blowing around me...)

271:t_1:12.en:
$$シモン$$
(It grew as strong as a storm, and then... it carried Bro away...)

271:t_1:13.en:
$$シモン$$
(But the wind never stopped. It pushed at the backs of me and my friends, and it swept through $$テッペリン$$ like a gale...)

271:t_1:14.en:
$$シモン$$
(And then the wind whirled into a vortex and carried us all the way to space...)

271:t_1:15.en:
$$シモン$$
(The wind became a spiral and is carrying us higher, farther still...)

271:t_1:16.en:
$$シモン$$
(The center of the galaxy... Break through the Tengen, and go higher, farther... stronger...)

271:t_1:21.en:
$n
「No! I... I don't want to die!!」

272:t_000:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, well... I wonder how many times that line has been said by now.」

272:t_000:2.en:
$$凱$$
「This is no time to be so carefree!」

272:t_000:3.en:
$$渓$$
「This place... it's totally different from any space we've been in until now!」

272:t_000:5.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Situation confirmed. The position sensor of the navigation system is pointing squarely at the center of the galaxy.」

272:t_000:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh? So this is the center point of the galaxy, is it?」

272:t_000:8.en:
$$渓$$
「No matter how you look at it, this place... it's different from the universe we came from!」

272:t_000:9.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「A report has come in from $$セイミー$$ in the hangar. For the time being, all $c units have been safely taken aboard.」

272:t_000:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...$$ＷＩＬＬ$$. Let me hear your view on our current location.」

272:t_000:11.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It would be natural to conclude that that $$時空震動$$ threw us into a different parallel world, but...」

272:t_000:12.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「As the sensors indicate, we cannot rule out the possibility that this really is the center point of the galaxy.」

272:t_000:14.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「What state the center point of the galaxy is in has never been observed.」

272:t_000:15.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「So we may be at the center point of the galaxy right now, a place no one has ever seen.」

272:t_000:16.en:
$$凱$$
「So there are things even $$ＷＩＬＬ$$, who knows everything, doesn't know...」

272:t_000:17.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Unfortunately, I am far from omniscient and omnipotent. And likely... few in all the parallel worlds know of the center point of the galaxy.」

272:t_000:19.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「According to my investigation, in the $$ＵＣＷ$$, the $$ＡＤＷ$$... and even in the individual worlds that formed them, the existence of the center point of the galaxy is unobservable.」

272:t_000:20.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The sole exception is the world $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ came from. Only in that world has the presence of a nest of $$宇宙怪獣$$ there been confirmed.」

272:t_000:21.en:
$$渓$$
「Then does this world, which has $$宇宙怪獣$$ too, have a nest of theirs as well?」

272:t_000:22.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I don't see anything that looks like one, though...」

272:t_000:23.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Even so, judging from the data recorded in $$チェインバー#pilot$$ and the situation so far, the center of the galaxy is certainly within the sphere of the species hostile to humanity.」

272:t_000:24.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It is quite likely that the $$サイデリアル$$'s activities are also aimed at exterminating them.」

272:t_000:25.en:
$$渓$$
「So they're trying to use Earth's $$次元力$$ to defeat $$バアル$$...」

272:t_000:26.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Judging by the act alone, it's admirable. It is truly an action to save the entire universe.」

272:t_000:28.en:
$$渓$$
「Yeah! Those guys are invaders, you know!」

272:t_000:29.en:
$$號$$
「$$渓$$, $$凱$$... Have you forgotten what Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$ told us?」

272:t_000:30.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life...」

272:t_000:31.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「And that gives birth to $$バアル$$...」

272:t_000:32.en:
$$田中司令$$
「In other words, if we can defeat $$バアル$$, we can stop the universe's rebirth... which is to say, its collapse. Is that the idea?」

272:t_000:33.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Just as $$ノリコ$$ and the others triumphed over the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

272:t_000:34.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, of course, if $$バアル$$ destroys us, what becomes of the universe afterward is no concern of ours.」

272:t_000:35.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ probably know this fact too, and have taken action on it.」

272:t_000:36.en:
$$渓$$
「I get what you're saying, but that doesn't mean I'm willing to accept those guys.」

272:t_000:37.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Naturally. As long as they try to force us into submission through violence, they're no different from $$バアル$$.」

272:t_000:38.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Still, this has been a very fruitful journey. I never imagined we would even obtain information about the universe's collapse.」

272:t_000:39.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「What remains is how to bring this back to Earth...」

272:t_000:40.en:
$$凱$$
「If it were the center of the galaxy, the distance would be insane, sure, but I figured we'd get home someday... But if this is a different parallel world...」

272:t_000:43.en:
$$渓$$
「...Look... I know this is no time to be saying this, but...」

272:t_000:44.en:
$$渓$$
「I was just thinking... this place is beautiful...」

272:t_000:46.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$渓$$ has an unexpectedly girlish side, doesn't she.」

272:t_000:47.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Having said that, I find myself thinking much the same thing.」

272:t_000:48.en:
$$凱$$
「...But now that you mention it, you're right...」

272:t_000:50.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Even I, who have traveled the galaxy, am seeing such a beautiful sight for the first time.」

272:t_000:51.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「What a pity. If we had more breathing room, we could have savored this beauty to the fullest.」

272:t_000:52.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...When it rains, it pours... It seems we are in even more of a pinch.」

272:t_000:53.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary confirmed. Something is transferring into this space.」

272:t_001:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, hurry and prepare to sortie. Since we don't know what is coming, we will meet it fully prepared.」

272:t_002:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! There are $$バジュラ$$ too!」

272:t_002:1.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「Those creatures like conch shells... They're the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ from $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s data.」

272:t_002:2.en:
$$凱$$
「Every enemy of humanity is gathered here at once!」

272:t_002:3.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「No coordination is seen between the forces, but they don't seem hostile to one another either. Their target appears to be us, after all.」

272:t_002:4.en:
$$渓$$
「They mean to intercept us for entering their territory!」

uncertain: 271:t_1:16: 天元を突破して rendered 'Break through the Tengen' (Simon's wind monologue; Tengen Toppa pun on the galactic center); wording unsure.
272:t_000:1: Tanaka's 'this line' = Gai's 'What is this place!?' (recurring joke about the cast saying it on every warp); inferred.
272:t_000:11: WILL says 'that spacequake'; kept as 'that $$時空震動$$'.
